historical_reviews.v3_1: OS NIC speed changes can disrupt management and require an owner-approved recovery path.

original_test_intent: Validate the dedicated BMC network path at each approved speed setting, including negotiated speed/duplex, connectivity, absence of errors and matching physical speed LED.
original_method: Bind OS interface, dedicated BMC connector and switch peer, baseline the link, apply approved OS speed settings one at a time, collect both-end negotiated state and reachability, photograph the LED and restore the final setting.
manual_activity: The owner approves the interface speed matrix and outage risk; an operator connects the exact cable, supervises each speed change and captures speed-specific LED evidence.
required_inputs: Dedicated connector, OS NIC and switch-port identity
Interruption window and alternate recovery path
safety_requirements: Do not run the CRPS stress substitution
Require approval for each configuration sequence
Stop on link loss, flapping or wrong peer
Do not alter BMC/switch settings unless separately approved
agent_execution_scope: Apply only approved OS NIC speed values
Collect negotiated speed/duplex and connectivity per value
Correlate operator LED photos and logs
Restore approved state without autonomous recovery or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable: CRPS power stress and SDR evidence belong to row 796 and cannot validate a network port.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the platform-approved OS NIC control plus complete OS/BMC/switch readback and reachability at each supported setting.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Power-on, RJ45, OS speed adjustment, internet/system/LED criteria, script and 5/5 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a topology-bound per-speed set-negotiate-connectivity-LED-restore sequence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact interface/peer identity, both-end negotiation, per-setting evidence and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Power-sensor stress provides zero network-speed coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsupported forced speed can drop the management path or cause link flapping.

project_override_considerations: If speed is controlled by the switch or BMC rather than the host interface, the project must document that ownership and preserve equivalent per-setting, both-end evidence; do not guess the control plane.
expected_evidence: Complete baseline and per-setting OS/BMC/switch link output
Restored final state, events, recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1518 consistently defines dedicated-port network speed. The reused-code CRPS row is a separate physical variant and its copied DeepSeek content is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, supported values, controls and recovery are finite project inputs, enabling conditional execution.

review_improvement: Rejects the duplicate CRPS workload and defines a speed-specific network negotiation, connectivity, LED and restoration test for the actual dedicated port.
independent_technical_reasoning: Speed adjustment is meaningful only when the controlling OS NIC, physical dedicated path and switch peer are mapped. The oracle must combine both-end negotiation, traffic reachability and physical LED, with recovery available before changing a management link.
